correctness.rationale: The vertex-labeled cubic graph, exact face predicate and all 561397 nonempty simplices are reconstructed by a standalone verifier. A complete 280690-pair matching has one critical 0-cell, eleven 7-cells and five 8-cells, with acyclicity proved by topologically sorting all 4345776 oriented Hasse incidences. Signed elimination reconstructs an exact 11×5 Morse boundary with two primitive unit factors; the seventh homotopy group of the 7-sphere wedge is free on those sphere inclusions, so the two unit attaching maps cancel and the other three attach trivially. This proves nine S7 and three S8 integrally, not only a numerical Betti claim. The result is finite and graph-specific.

value.rationale: The 24-vertex cubic symmetric Nauru graph is a canonical, independently motivated graph, already studied for ordinary independence. Its first higher-independence complex has a new natural mixed-dimensional integral homotopy type with independent degree-seven and degree-eight sphere summands. Such a complete classification is mathematically informative beyond face counts or a field-only Betti table; no general-family theorem is claimed.
